verdict.rationale: Superset runs and orchestrates parallel coding agents in isolated worktrees, so a repository agent-readiness report is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence documents a feature that evaluates or scores a repository's readiness for autonomous agents. Mentions of sharing agent-created reports and of setup/teardown scripts are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run a readiness report that evaluates how ready my repository is for autonomous agents
